thread:
amy.k: Heads-up: FinCorp asked for a tidy evidence bundle for tenant-42 before their audit tomorrow morning. They want RBAC export, audit events (90d), KMS envelope/rotation proof, and a concise incident note for recent log-agent fix.
devon.l: I can grab the RBAC export. Should we include system/service accounts that have infra-level scope?
hassan: include them but label as infra/service and show explicit scope and last-use timestamps. Also include policy_version for bindings.
tara.ops: I'll run the audit pull and redact PII. Rule: redact full usernames and file paths; keep actor type, action, resource-id (tenant-scoped), and timestamp.
sec-bot: [auto] KMS envelope proof template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/kms-evidence-template. Includes key alias, wrap alg, and rotation events summary.
devon.l: RBAC command I'll run: `redwoodctl iam export --scope tenant:42 --format json` then filter with `jq` to separate user vs service principals.
tara.ops: Audit query plan: `GET /audit/_search {"query":{"bool":{"must":[{"term":{"tenant_id":"42"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-90d"}}}]}}}` then `redact-tool --rules security/redact.yml`.
hassan: For keys I'll attach `kms-cli describe-key alias/tenant42-root` and `kms-cli history --key alias/tenant42-root --since 2024-01-01`. Ops lead will sign a short statement that no plaintext tenant keys were stored in S3.
amy.k: Also include SIEM delivery receipts for forwards to their Splunk/EFK endpoint. Presigned proof acceptable for 7 days.
devon.l: ETA RBAC: 90m. tara.ops: audit export ETA 2.5h. hassan: KMS artefacts ETA 1h.
amy.k: One other ask: note the remediated bug CVE-2026-0801 in the audit-agent, patch applied 2026-03-10, re-ingest completed 2026-03-12. Add ticket SEC-4710 and verification artefacts.
tara.ops: I'll include a short recreate script so their SRE can validate locally and a redaction checklist.
devon.l: Filenames for bundle: `rbac_tenant42.json`, `audit_tenant42_redacted.ndjson`, `kms_envelope_tenant42.pdf`, `kms_rotation_tenant42.csv`, `siem_receipts_tenant42.json`, `incident_SEC-4710.pdf`.
amy.k: We'll store originals in `s3://redwood-evidence/SEC-4710/tenant42/` with restricted ACL; bundle contains redacted copies and signed statements.
sec-bot: [auto] Evidence checklist validated.
amy.k: I'll assemble and send presigned link to FinCorp once uploads complete. If anything slips, tag @oncall for triage.
tara.ops: uploading audit export now to `/secure-share/fincorp/tenant42/` and will generate 7-day presigned URL.
devon.l: RBAC uploaded. hassan: KMS docs uploaded and ops lead signed note attached.
amy.k: Packet ready and link shared with customer. Closing thread.
